  P5->>P2: writes events
  P1->>P4: implements
  P2->>P6: configures sink
  P6->>P7: creates sink
  P7->>P8: captures events
  P7--)P9: uses request context
  P7--)P10: uses user context
  P8--)P11: sends telemetry
  P9->>P4: reads request data
  P10->>P4: reads user data
